sections.title: Delivery accelerators
sections.subtitle: Reusable packs and playbooks for dependable delivery

sections.heading: Reuse the groundwork. Focus on the change.
sections.body:
Delivery accelerators are reusable packs and playbooks that support software change from modernisation and integration through testing and release. They provide a starting point that teams can adapt to the systems and delivery needs of each engagement.

Bring migration checks, regression coverage, security controls and compliance preparation into the delivery plan. Select the relevant packs, tailor them to the scope and use them to make readiness easier to review.

sections.heading: Reusable IP across delivery
sections.description: Five packs and playbooks for a more controlled path to release.

cards.title: Modernisation & Integration
cards.description: Reuse patterns for updating applications and connecting systems, with checks shaped around the interfaces and dependencies involved.

cards.title: Migration & regression packs
cards.description: Apply repeatable migration checks and regression coverage to verify data movement and preserve expected application behaviour.

cards.title: Automated Testing & Release Assurance
cards.description: Build automated checks into delivery and review test evidence before release to identify regressions and readiness gaps.

cards.title: Cyber-Safe Delivery
cards.description: Include security checks and controlled delivery practices throughout change, rather than leaving them to the final release stage.

cards.title: Regulatory & Compliance Readiness
cards.description: Organise requirements, control checks and delivery evidence to support compliance reviews without implying automatic regulatory approval.

sections.heading: Fit the packs to your delivery plan

items.description: Review the change scope, system dependencies and delivery risks. Identify the controls and evidence the project will need.
Select the relevant packs and playbooks. Adapt their checks and patterns to the technology, data and requirements in scope.
Build the packs into the delivery workflow. Run migration, regression and security checks at the appropriate stages.
Review the results before release. Resolve gaps, retain the delivery evidence and update the reusable checks as the system evolves.
